package.name: rosidl_typesupport_tickle_cpp
package.description: Thin C++-level companion to rosidl_typesupport_tickle_c. rclcpp's create_publisher()/ create_subscription() never hand rmw_create_publisher() a C-level rosidl_message_type_support_t - they always start from the C++-level "rosidl_typesupport_cpp" dispatch, whose own per-message candidate list is built at *generate* time from whichever packages are registered as a "rosidl_typesupport_cpp" ament_index resource (see rosidl_typesupport_cpp's own idl__type_ support.cpp.em template - the exact same extension-point pattern rosidl_typesupport_fastrtps_cpp/ rosidl_typesupport_introspection_cpp already use). Without an entry in *that* list, rosidl_typesupport_tickle_c is structurally unreachable from any real rclcpp C++ node, no matter how correct its own C-level dispatch table is - this package exists purely to close that gap by registering "rosidl_typesupport_tickle_cpp" there and, per message, delegating straight through to the existing rosidl_typesupport_tickle_c symbol (no duplicated encode/decode logic - see cmake/rosidl_typesupport_tickle_cpp_generate_interfaces.cmake).
